verdict.headline: Quiet run.
verdict.detail: Quiet run. Squad is legal, stable and unleveraged, and nothing on the board improves the eleven inside the unwind ceiling. The flip mechanism is dead (no manager asks below market value). The one live item is Bernardo: angeschlagen since the Koeln game but still in Hoffenheim's projected XI for MD2 - keep him unless Friday's confirmed lineup drops him. SO WHY IT IS STILL AN AVOID - TWO REASONS, AND THE FIRST IS THE DURABLE ONE. (1) THE +93 IS AN ARTEFACT OF USING ap=199, WHICH IS ONE MATCH. Post-move the fielded XI is 1289 + his score, so BREAK-EVEN IS A SCORE OF 106 - almost exactly his 25/26 mean of 106,3. The move buys nothing at his central expectation: at 110 it is +4, at 120 it is +14, at 100 it is -6, at 80 it is -26. The +93 headline is measuring his best game, not his level. GENERAL LESSON: when comparing a one-match ap against squad players who also have one-match ap, the comparison is noise-on-noise; always re-price the swap at the candidate's multi-season mean before believing a big number. (2) THE STRUCTURAL COST IS WORSE THAN THE POINTS. The only unwind that clears zero is Bernardo + Lokonga, which lands him at exactly 11 players INCLUDING Amoako - who is ap 0 and not even on HSV's bench - with 272.468 of cash. At 11 players no further sale is legal and 272.468 buys nothing, so he would be FROZEN: a dead body forced into the XI every matchday from MD3 on, with no way out. The do-nothing baseline instead ends at 11 players who ALL produce, plus 5.746.969 of cash and full freedom to add a 12th body. So the same 1395 comes with a healthy squad in one branch and a trapped one in the other. (3) EXECUTION MAKES IT WORSE STILL: max solvent bid is 20.834.185 = mv +1,33%, against a measured Kickbase board cluster of +9% to +48%. A bid he can actually afford is near-certain to lose, and a bid that wins above 20.834.185 CANNOT BE UNWOUND - both sales are already spent - which means a negative balance at the lock and ZERO points for all of MD2. REVERSAL: only if he is relisted when the squad has 13+ players with 2+ droppable bodies, or cash above ~21M, so the buy does not have to be paid for out of the fielded eleven. killed_this_run.name: Fabio Vieira (11967) — and THE UNWIND-CEILING DOCTRINE that kills every big buy at 12 players
killed_this_run.why: READ THE DOCTRINE BEFORE EVER RECOMMENDING A BUY ABOVE ~4M. Vieira is the best-looking buy the board has produced and he is still a REJECT, and the reason generalises. THE PLAYER IS GENUINELY GOOD - this is not a quality rejection. Fabio Vieira (11967), HSV (tid 6, tn "Hamburg"), pos 3 MID, st 0 fit, mv 18.586.935, cv 18.500.000, mvt 0, listed by KICKBASE (no u field) at prc = mv exactly, ofc 0, dt 2026-09-03T00:39:10Z, expiry 2026-09-04T01:07Z. HE HAS NO 26/27 POINTS ONLY BECAUSE HE WAS STILL AN ARSENAL PLAYER ON MD1 - get_player_performance confirms ph [{hp:false}] for MD1 (Dortmund 2:0 HSV 29.08). DO NOT apply the "cheap player with no history" heuristic to him and DO NOT apply the refuted 500.000 rule: he has a FULL 25/26 Bundesliga season at HSV on loan - 29 scoring appearances, 25 starts, season ap 96, tp 2795, mean 104,8 over starts, mean 108,3 over his last 13, with 217/201/195/178/177/158/157 highs. A realistic ap is 95-115. Ligainsider HSV page (stand 01.09.2026 20:31, post-MD1) names him in the probable XI at CAM v Mainz 06.09 15:30 - AFTER the MD2 lock, so he would count. THE ARITHMETIC IS WHY HE IS AN AVOID, and it was computed by brute force over every 2-sale unwind and all eight legal shapes. Doing NOTHING and just fixing the lineup gives 5-3-2 = 1395 fielded ap for free. Buying Vieira AT MV (18.586.935) takes cash 4.037.522 to MINUS 14.549.413. The squad becomes 13, so exactly TWO sales are legal before the 11-man floor. The ONLY 2-sale combo that gets the balance back to non-negative is Bernardo + Lokonga (7.048.552 + 9.748.111 = 16.796.663 -> +2.247.250), and that leaves 11 = 1/4/4/2 fielding 1385 at ap 96 or 1399 at ap 110. So the whole operation is worth MINUS 10 to PLUS 4 points against doing nothing for free. At +10% over mv it is +388.556 balance and the same 1385-1399. At +20% (the middle of the corrected Kickbase band) NO combo except selling Minjae or Matsima clears zero and the best XI drops to 1351, strictly WORSE than 1395. Adding a second cheap buy to unlock a third sale was also priced: Vieira + Ndiaye then selling Bernardo+Lokonga+Widmer gives 1370. Also worse. THE DOCTRINE, which is the durable part: SPENDING POWER IS AN ILLUSION AT 12 PLAYERS. kb_context prints spending power 54.721.905 and that number is real for the 33% floor, but it is NOT purchasing capacity, because CASH is only 4.037.522 and a negative balance at matchday start scores ZERO for the whole matchday. Every euro above cash must be earned back by SALES before the lock, and the number of sales is capped at (squad size - 11), not by what he owns. At 12 players that is ONE sale; at 13 after a buy it is TWO. His only points-free bodies are Amoako (1.709.447) and Widmer (1.853.282), so his TRUE buying capacity without touching the fielded eleven is about 4.037.522 + 1.709.447 + 1.853.282 = 7.600.251. Anything above that is paid for in fielded points, and the points a big buy adds are handed straight back by the players he must sell to unwind. THE TEST A FUTURE RUN MUST RUN BEFORE RECOMMENDING ANY BUY: price the FULLY UNWOUND end state (balance >= 0, squad >= 11, best legal XI) against the do-nothing optimum. If it does not beat it by a clear margin, it is an AVOID no matter how good the player is. HOW VIEIRA COULD BECOME A BUY: only once the squad has genuine spare bodies - 13+ players of which 2+ are droppable - or once cash is above ~15M. Neither is reachable before the 2026-09-04T18:30Z lock. ALSO AVOIDED THIS RUN, same board sweep: Moussa Ndiaye (13449), Werder DEF, mv 1.870.307, Kickbase listing at mv, expiry 2026-09-03T20:42Z, no points history and no dated news - a 12th-body candidate only, and Georg already has the 12th body he is trying to sell.
